patch_description: Canonicalize the unordered nine free points by spatial order throughout the evolutionary phase. Triangle quality is invariant under permutations of point labels, but differential evolution and coordinate-wise crossover are not: without a canonical representation, two geometrically similar layouts can have unrelated point indices, causing donor differences and crossover to combine incompatible locations. Sorting free points into a deterministic y-then-x order makes corresponding genes represent similar spatial roles, improving the usefulness of current-to-elite DE while retaining the same feasible search space and deterministic behavior.
